original_test_intent: Validate each Type 20 Ending Address as the inclusive final boundary of the correct memory-device mapped range, with valid legacy/extended encoding, Type 17 identity, Type 19 containment and reboot persistence.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 17/19/20 and OS-map data, resolve device/parent-range handles, choose endpoint encoding by sentinel/length, pair the end with the same record's start, validate inclusive size/containment/interleaving, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies expected device ranges/interleave semantics and approves reboot; no physical memory action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Type 17 device and parent Type 19 ranges
Legacy/extended sentinel, units and inclusive-end rules
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/OS-map queries; never alter DIMMs, mapping, kernel or firmware.
Resolve both handles and pair end with the same record's start before judgment.
Preserve raw encodings and handle inclusive-end arithmetic/overflow; never truncate extended addresses.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on reversed/out-of-parent range or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Select authoritative endpoint representation, resolve device/array handles, calculate inclusive per-device range and validate containment/interleave policy before and after reboot.
Report orphan, off-by-one, reversed, overlapping, out-of-array or drifting records without setting the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve device/array range, boundary and interleaving expectations plus reboot plan.
Interpret legitimate logical mapping differences and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Ending Address is relevant, but grep loses same-record start, inclusive arithmetic, encoding mode and Type 17/19 relationships.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 17/19/20 plus OS map; report raw legacy/extended endpoints, resolved handles, normalized inclusive range/capacity, containment/interleave result and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Type 20 Ending Address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select the valid Type 20 end representation, pair it with the same start, resolve device/parent handles, validate inclusive range size and containment/interleaving, and compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems with Type 17/19/20 memory mapping.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17/19/20 address, inclusive-boundary and handle definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds encoding mode, start pairing, inclusive capacity and topology containment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects off-by-one, wrong-device, reversed and out-of-parent ends missed by a label grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved per-device ranges and interleave/boundary policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Logical/interleaved ranges may not equal simple DIMM capacity and require documented platform semantics.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define device-specific logical/interleaved ranges, but every expected end must remain paired with the exact start and handles; overrides cannot change inclusive SMBIOS semantics.
expected_evidence: Approved Type 17/19/20 topology, address and inclusive-end policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 17/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-record raw endpoints, resolved handles, normalized inclusive range/capacity and containment result
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot per-device diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Ending Address is a valid Type 20 field; expected device topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Encoding, inclusive arithmetic, handle and containment checks are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds record identity, paired start, inclusive boundary and device/array topology.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains range safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing topology/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from automation capability.

review_improvement: Prevents an ending value from passing when it is off by one, unpaired, assigned to the wrong device or outside its array.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ending-address validity is deterministic once its encoding, paired start and handle topology are preserved; no manual core observation is needed.
